study_identification_part.si_4_title: Investigating dopaminergic abnormalities in schizophrenia and /uniFB01 rst-episode psychosis with normative modelling and multisite molecular neuroimaging

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Multiple datasets without standard consortium names: two [11C]-(+)-PHNO datasets (PET/CT, PET/MR) and six [18F]FDOPA datasets (FDOPA_HC01, FDOPA_HC02, FDOPA_01-04) collected across multiple scanners/sites.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "we used two datasets [40, 41] of [ 11 C]-( + )-PHNO PET imaging data... acquired with two scanners"; "The datasets consisted of two datasets of HC only (FDOPA_HC01 and FDOPA_HC02), three case-control datasets (FDOPA_01, FDOPA_02, and FDOPA_03) and one dataset of patients only (FDOPA_04)."; "Data were acquired with five different scanners... in three different imaging sites"

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: PHNO datasets were used to compare harmonization methods; FDOPA HC datasets were used to estimate the normative model, and FDOPA patient datasets (including one without matched HC) were used to compute deviations and clinical analyses.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "we used two datasets [40, 41] of [ 11 C]-( + )-PHNO PET imaging data... to compare the effects of two image harmonisation methods"; "we used the estimated [ 18 F]FDOPA PET model to calculate the deviations from normality in four datasets... one of which did not include any matched HC"; "The datasets consisted of two datasets of HC only (FDOPA_HC01 and FDOPA_HC02), three case-control datasets (FDOPA_01, FDOPA_02, and FDOPA_03) and one dataset of patients only (FDOPA_04)."

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: PHNO datasets report mean (SD) ages: PET/CT 26.52 (7.87), PET/MR 24.39 (4.90); weighted mean and pooled SD computed across N=54 and N=23. FDOPA age statistics are reported by dataset but not explicitly for HC-only vs case-control controls, so overall HC-only age for the FDOPA normative model is NR (reported dataset means include FDOPA_01 26.25 (5.18), FDOPA_02 29.00 (8.70), FDOPA_03 44.52 (9.97), FDOPA_04 30.63 (10.91), FDOPA_HC01 29.42 (6.09), FDOPA_HC02 24.43 (4.65)).

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: PHNO datasets report sex counts: PET/CT 22F/32M and PET/MR 12F/11M (combined to overall 34F/43M; percentages computed). FDOPA sex counts are reported by dataset but not explicitly for HC-only controls vs patient samples; HC-only datasets report FDOPA_HC01 14F/22M and FDOPA_HC02 1F/6M, while case-control datasets list combined totals (e.g., FDOPA_01 32F/55M; FDOPA_02 17F/33M; FDOPA_03 21F/13M; FDOPA_04 8F/28M).
